### ✅ **TASK 1: Deviation Detection Script (Exact 3.75% Logic)**

#### 🔢 **Core Formula (Mathematically Precise)**
Given:
- `rolling_avg` = 7-day rolling average of `user_activity_events` volume (including current day)
- `current_volume` = ingestion count for today (UTC)

> **Deviation threshold:**  
> $$
> \text{Threshold} = \text{rolling\_avg} \times 0.0375
> $$

> **Alert condition (strictly greater than):**  
> $$
> \left| \frac{\text{current\_volume} - \text{rolling\_avg}}{\text{rolling\_avg}} \right| > 0.0375
> $$

This means:
- If `current_volume < rolling_avg × (1 - 0.0375)` → **below threshold**
- If `current_volume > rolling_avg × (1 + 0.0375)` → **above threshold**

> ✅ **No rounding allowed** — all calculations use full decimal precision.
